row.title: Unlearn improves itself: grounded review labels, automatic re-grading, Lab discovery, wording trials
row.body: Rowan asked to grow Unlearn and make it run and improve automatically. Decision: a model may only label or re-word, never add facts; every label or draft must quote a sentence present in the abstract it read, re-words may add no number or name, entries' cited sources are never changed by a model, drafts live on /lab and are never published as entries, and wording trials need 40 answers per arm and a two-proportion z of 1.96 to replace the original.

title: Unlearn improves itself: grounded review labels, automatic re-grading, Lab discovery, wording trials
